title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
transcription:
Mary Had a Little
Lamb

Leader:
Mary had a little lamb,
its fleece was white as snow.
Group:
Shouting out the battle cry of freedom.
Leader:
And every where that Mary went,
that lamb was sure to go.
Group:
Shouting out the battle cry of freedom.

Chorus (All):
Hurrah for the Mary,
hurrah for the lamb,
hurrah for the teacher
Who didn't give a
Particle if all the lambs in Idaho
went marching down to school,
Shouting out the battle cry of freedom.

Other lines:
...she put it on the shelf,
...and every time it turned around,
it spanked its little self.

...she tied it to the heater
...and every time it turned around,
it burned its little seater.

...she put it in the closet
...and every time that Mary looked,
it left a fresh deposit.

...a mosquito loves a hairless man,
with him he's quite at home.
...no finer pasture can be found
than on that bald man's dome.

...I coat my legs with honey,
each day a half a cup.
...it makes my legs quite sticky,
but it keeps my stockings up.

...I eat my peas with honey,
I've done it all my life.
...it makes my peas taste funny,
but it keeps them on my knife.

...The lightning bug is very dumb,
he hasn't any mind.
...he travels all the way through life
with his headlight on behind.
